skills.name: chameleon-partials
skills.description: Renders reusable HTML fragments (partials) inside Chameleon templates for any Python web framework that renders Chameleon, such as Pyramid or FastAPI. Use when adding chameleon_partials to an app, calling render_partial from a .pt template or from Python, wiring render_partial into Pyramid (BeforeRender) or another framework (extend_model), testing partials with pytest, or fixing PartialsException, ValueError "Template not found", NameError: render_partial, escaped markup, or template edits that do not show up.
